question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
-- Clean up: use CAST to integer for clean output
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS top_id,
        p.name AS top_name,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        CAST(pr.qty AS BIGINT) AS level_qty,
        1 AS depth
    FROM packaging p
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = p.id
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        h.top_name,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        h.level_qty * CAST(pr.qty AS BIGINT) AS level_qty,
        h.depth + 1
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = h.current_id
)
SELECT 
    h.top_name AS container_name,
    p.name AS item_name,
    CAST(SUM(h.level_qty) AS BIGINT) AS total_qty
FROM hierarchy h
JOIN packaging p ON p.id = h.current_id
WHERE h.current_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
GROUP BY h.top_name, p.name, h.top_id, p.id
HAVING SUM(h.level_qty) > 500
ORDER BY h.top_name, total_qty DESC;

{"sql": "-- Let me think about this differently. The question asks about "items" in the context of packaging hierarchy.
-- The "items" are the leaf-level packaging items. Let me compute the total accumulated quantity

-- First, let me identify leaf packaging items (those that never appear as packaging_id)
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    -- Base: top-level packaging containers (not contained in any other)
    SELECT 
        p.id AS top_id,
        p.name AS top_name,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS level_qty,
        1 AS depth
    FROM packaging p
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = p.id
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: follow the chain down
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        h.top_name,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        h.level_qty * pr.qty AS level_qty,
        h.depth + 1
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = h.current_id
)
SELECT 
    h.top_id,
    h.top_name,
    p.id AS item_id,
    p.name AS item_name,
    SUM(h.level_qty) AS total_qty
FROM hierarchy h
JOIN packaging p ON p.id = h.current_id
WHERE h.current_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
GROUP BY h.top_id, h.top_name, p.id, p.name
ORDER BY h.top_id, total_qty DESC;"}
